summary: This is a Form 6-K filed by Telecom Argentina S.A. reporting consolidated results for the first quarter of fiscal year 2026 (1Q26). The filing discloses financial and operational metrics such as revenues, margins, customer base evolution, and net income. It discusses segment performance, including the contribution of TMA, and notes the adoption of inflationary accounting. There is no mention of any merger, acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC activity, or forced management change. The filing is a routine earnings release by a foreign private issuer, thus not a special situation.
